Floodplain hectares beside each segment, from a catalog item's floodplain

Source: R/floodplain_ha.R
knw_floodplain_ha.Rd

The stac-floodplains-bc catalog publishes, per watershed group, a whole-network floodplain (all_ff04) and its attribution by blue line (all_ff04_by_blue_line_key): exact 30 m BC Albers cells, each blue line claiming the cells of its own valley, so the claims overlap where valleys meet. This rasterises all_ff04 on that same 30 m grid (no reprojection; the cell count times 0.09 ha reproduces the polygon's area), takes the blue-line polygons as the claims, and gives every floodplain cell one owner with flooded::fl_valley_join(): the nearest segment among the claiming blue lines' segments (nearest, one owner per cell, so hectares add up). Each segment's hectares are its cells times 0.09; graded hectares are hectares times the segment's grade, so 500 ha beside grade-0.9 habitat is 450 and the same 500 ha beside grade-0.3 habitat is 150.

Usage

knw_floodplain_ha(gpkg, segments, flags, scenario = "all_ff04")

Arguments

gpkg

character(1) the item's floodplain.gpkg.

segments

an sf of the group's link segments in EPSG:3005 with id_segment, blue_line_key, logical flag columns flags, and grade.

flags

character the logical columns (habitat under each rule, accessible) to carry; fl_valley_join() takes logical columns only.

scenario

character(1) the floodplain layer and the attribution layer's prefix.

Value

A list: segments, segments with fp_ha and fp_graded_ha added; summary, one row per flag: hectares beside segments where the flag holds, graded hectares, and hectares by grade class; check, fl_valley_join()'s cell accounting plus the polygon area and the raster's area in km².

Details

Needs flooded with nearest$seg (flooded#89).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
seg <- sf::st_read(conn, query = "SELECT id_segment, blue_line_key, geom FROM fresh_default.streams
                                  WHERE watershed_group_code = 'LARL'")
seg$rearing_default <- ...; seg$rearing_tuned <- ...; seg$grade <- ...
fp <- knw_floodplain_ha("larl_floodplain.gpkg", seg, c("rearing_default", "rearing_tuned"))
fp$summary
} # }
